memory_model: 64-byte writable line model; response delay is a simulation parameter

metric_definitions.l1_hit_miss: accepted CPU request classified by L1 MESI state; S-store is a miss/upgrade
metric_definitions.l2_refill_hit_miss: accepted Directory L2 refill lookup; not a count of all metadata probes
metric_definitions.memory_bandwidth: accepted 64-bit R/W line beats times eight bytes, divided by benchmark cycles
metric_definitions.ops_per_cycle: completed CPU operations divided by the measured window cycles
metric_definitions.phase_cycles: observed same-line milestone deltas: L1 miss to Directory acceptance, Directory acceptance to L2 refill lookup, L2 hit to grant or L2 miss to backing-memory request, and accepted memory request to final response beat/write response; L2 metadata lookup itself is combinational
metric_definitions.seeded_mixed_dual_core: five fixed seeds, dual-core paired and single-lane reads/writes, independent architectural scoreboards, final readback of all target lines
